hotel.name: The St. Regis Red Sea Resort

verified_facts.text: The resort is on a private island in the Ummahat archipelago in Saudi Arabia's Red Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on a pristine private island, The St. Regis Red Sea Resort presents exquisite living in the Ummahat archipelago.

verified_facts.text: The island is reached from the Saudi coast by speedboat or seaplane.
verified_facts.excerpt: Accessed from the coast of Saudi Arabia via speedboat or seaplane

verified_facts.text: A seaplane transfer from Red Sea International Airport to the island takes 25 minutes.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ummahat islands can be reached by a 25-minute seaplane transfer from The Red Sea International Airport

verified_facts.text: The resort's architecture is by Kengo Kuma.
verified_facts.excerpt: Individual architecture by Kengo Kuma reflects the organic shapes of the landscape

verified_facts.text: Every villa has a private pool and sundeck.
verified_facts.excerpt: each of the 90 spacious villas feature a private pool and sundeck

verified_facts.text: Villas are either beachfront Dune Villas or overwater Coral Villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: comprising beachfront Dune Villas and overwater Coral Villas

verified_facts.text: Villas range from one to four bedrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Accommodations range from one- to four-bedroom villas

verified_facts.text: The overwater Coral Villas have a distinctive spiral form.
verified_facts.excerpt: overwater Coral Villas feature a distinctive spiral form that showcases panoramic views

verified_facts.text: Each villa faces west to catch the sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expertly positioned, each villa captures the beauty of sunset from an inspired, west-facing aspect.

verified_facts.text: Premium sedan and speedboat transfers are included in the room rate.
verified_facts.excerpt: Premium sedan and speedboat transfers are included in your room rate.

verified_facts.text: Every stay includes the St. Regis Butler Service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every stay is elevated by the signature St. Regis Butler Service

verified_facts.text: Butlers handle unpacking and packing of luggage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy signature services including, unpacking and packing luggage

verified_facts.text: Nesma serves Middle Eastern cuisine made from local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Serving Middle Eastern cuisine made from local ingredients, Nesma is a standout restaurant

verified_facts.text: Gishiki 45 serves modern Japanese food with live cooking and an omakase experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor modern Japanese dining at Gishiki 45, where live cooking and an exclusive omakase experience are elevated by time-honored rituals.

verified_facts.text: Tilina Steakhouse sits above the reef with sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floating above the reef, Tilina combines sea views with a refined dining experience.

verified_facts.text: The resort's signature Bloody Mary, the Coral Mary, uses dried black lime and algae.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its vibrant coral hue combines with desert sand inspired, dried black lime, ubiquitous to every Saudi home

verified_facts.text: Each evening at the violet hour the resort celebrates with the art of sabrage.
verified_facts.excerpt: As day transitions to night and the beguiling ‘violet hour’ descends, celebrate with the traditional art of sabrage.

verified_facts.text: Private chefs can cook tailored menus served in your villa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our private chefs are on hand to craft tailored recipes, served in the privacy of your accommodation.

verified_facts.text: Watersports are run by WAMA, including paddleboarding, kayaking, windsurfing, e-foil and wing-sup.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ease into resort life with stand-up paddleboarding and gentle kayaking or take advantage of the island breeze with a thrilling windsurf, e-foil or wing-sup ride.

verified_facts.text: The Galaxea dive center is on the neighboring island of Nujuma.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the neighboring island of Nujuma, Galaxea diving center welcomes those looking to explore the Red Sea’s underwater world.

verified_facts.text: Galaxea offers conservation and heritage dives, snorkeling excursions and PADI courses for all levels.
verified_facts.excerpt: divers of all levels can enjoy everything from conservation and heritage dives, through to snorkeling excursions and PADI courses

verified_facts.text: Guests can kayak or paddleboard through the Sheybarah Downwind mangrove forests with WAMA.
verified_facts.excerpt: Navigate a winding network of waterways on a WAMA excursion to the Sheybarah Downwind mangrove forests

verified_facts.text: The spa works with skincare partner AMRA.
verified_facts.excerpt: AMRA brings luxurious and pioneering therapies to The St. Regis Spa

verified_facts.text: The spa offers a Gold Hot Stone Massage using 24kt Gold Body Oil.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Gold Hot Stone Massage is a sensorial ritual where the body is bathed in 24kt Gold Body Oil

verified_facts.text: There is an open-air Yoga Pavilion.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Yoga Pavilion is an open-air platform from which to practice yoga and meditation

verified_facts.text: The spa interiors feature mother-of-pearl, shell accents and jellyfish-inspired chandeliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: the spa features immersive interiors with mother-of-pearl, shell accents, wave-like seating, and jellyfish-inspired chandeliers

verified_facts.text: There are two open-air courts for tennis and padel.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy a game of tennis or padel at our two specially designed open-air courts

verified_facts.text: The Kids Club is complimentary and has an indoor play area and an outdoor playground.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Kids Club features a dedicated indoor play area, arts and crafts station, reading corner, interactive games, outdoor playground

verified_facts.text: The resort was developed to LEED Platinum certification standards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Developed in accordance with LEED Platinum certification standards

verified_facts.text: Over 190,000 mangroves have been planted on the island with Red Sea Global.
verified_facts.excerpt: over 190,000 mangroves have been planted with the support of Red Sea Global

verified_facts.text: The resort says it is powered entirely by solar energy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built to LEED Platinum standards and powered entirely by solar energy

verified_facts.text: Low light pollution makes the island good for stargazing.
verified_facts.excerpt: The location’s naturally low light pollution also offers excellent conditions for stargazing

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: The hotel says it remains open and operational amid the regional situation in the Middle East.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel remains open and operational and our teams are focused on supporting our guests at this time.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is complimentary for hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, complimentary breakfast is available at The St. Regis Red Sea Resort to hotel guests during their stay.
